title: Hidden Bathroom Secret
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan/Shinichi, Ran, Kogoro, Inspector Megure, Professor Agasa, and Haibara/Ai/Shiho herself) omitted by convention -- no `event` node type, actions are direct typed edges between the entities involved. The old case file's stated culprit (Imai) is confirmed by the transcript, but its motive/timeline was compressed and slightly off: it frames the motive as Dejima 'colluding with rival companies to prevent Imai from starting an independent firm.' The transcript is more specific and two-staged -- Imai DID go independent 20 years ago; Dejima secretly got publishing-house contacts to blacklist him ('don't give that traitor any work'), forcing his return, and Imai began plotting murder then, but abandoned it after young Akemi (Haibara's sister, visiting with her parents) unknowingly charmed him out of it. The actual murder happens now because Imai tried going independent a second time, Dejima freshly insulted him ('your sense just isn't there anymore'), and adult Akemi -- who had promised to visit again -- never returned. The Haibara-family/Black-Organization thread running through both episodes (Akemi's hidden cassette tapes, two break-ins, planted listening devices) is the story's structural red herring: characters explicitly suspect 'the men in black' killed Dejima to pressure Haibara, before Conan rules that out and pins it on Imai by ordinary means (a cyanide-laced toilet-paper roll plus laxative-primed timing). Akemi/Atsushi Miyano/Elena Miyano are included as backstory_figure persons for this reason, unlike the old file which omitted the 'Haibara family backstory... as unrelated.' The post-credits Calvados/sniper teaser belongs to the next episode's arc and is excluded here. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Poison traces present on Dejima's left hand, right pants side, belt hole, handkerchief, and burger wrapper, but absent from the coffee-cup handle and cookie packaging -- rules out the cup/cookies and points to something handled and then discarded, i.e. the toilet-paper roll.

Poison found on the right side of Dejima's pants, not the left -- if his poisoned hand had touched the left-side flush lever it would show on the left; instead it matches only holding the roll while opening the door right-handed.

No full-flush water sound was heard when Zaitsu used the bathroom, even though Dejima had everyone save water since Akemi's visit -- proving Zaitsu only urinated and never touched the fresh roll, clearing him and fixing the poisoning to whoever set the roll up beforehand.

edges.motive_type: revenge_for_blacklisting (Dejima colluded with publishing contacts to get Imai blacklisted after his first attempt to go independent, then freshly insulted his second attempt)

edges.method: potassium cyanide absorbed handling a poisoned toilet-paper roll, timed with a laxative-laced coffee to force the bathroom visit
